defs.def: the amount of money that sb asks for goods and services （商品和服务所需的）要价，收费

ex.s: So, it’s been useful to know how to cover up holes and repaint a room to avoid any charges when I’ve moved out.”
ex.t: 所以，懂得如何遮盖墙洞并重新粉刷房间，以便搬家时避免任何扣费，一直很有用。

ex.s: After the second week of classes, there will be a charge for each schedule change.
ex.t: 开课两周后，每次更改课表都将收费。

ex.s: Failure to provide enough chaperones will result in an extra charge of $50 per absent adult.
ex.t: 若未提供足够的监护人，每位缺席的成人将额外收取50美元。

ex.s: Drinks now contain 45 million fewer kilos of sugar as a result of manufacturers' efforts to avoid the charge, according to Treasury analysis.
ex.t: 据英国财政部分析，由于制造商们努力规避糖税，饮料中的糖含量如今减少了4500万公斤。

ex.s: He 23   to fix bikes free of charge for anyone who needed it.
ex.t: 他   23   承诺免费为任何需要的人修理自行车。

ex.s: A special low entrance charge of £2 per person is available to all in full-time education, up to and including those at first degree level, in organised groups with teachers.
ex.t: 对所有全日制教育者，包括处于本科学位层次的人，在有教师组织的团体中，每人2英镑的特别低入场费适用。

ex.s: Your card will be produced free of charge.
ex.t: 你的卡将免费制作。

ex.s: Your replacement card will be produced free of charge.
ex.t: 你的换卡将免费制作。

defs.def: to record the cost of sth as an amount that sb has to pay 把 … 记在账上；在某人账上记入
an official claim made by the police that sb has committed a crime 指控；控告
a statement accusing sb of doing sth wrong or bad 指责；谴责
a position of having control over sb/sth; responsibility for sb/sth 主管；掌管；照管；职责；责任

ex.s: They are captured and taken inside the submarine, where they meet the man in charge, Captain Nemo.
ex.t: 他们被俘并带进潜水艇，在那里见到了负责人尼摩船长。

ex.s: In 1959, he took charge of Liverpool Football Club and established it as one of the major forces in the English and European football.
ex.t: 1959年，他接管了利物浦足球俱乐部，并将其确立为英格兰和欧洲足球的主要力量之一。

ex.s: He received a hero’s welcome from his homeland and was put in charge of not only developing China’s rocket science but also its space and missile programme.
ex.t: 他受到了来自祖国的英雄般的欢迎，不仅负责开发中国的火箭科学，还负责其太空和导弹计划。

ex.s: Will you be completely in charge of your own life and able to express yourself in new and exciting ways?
ex.t: 您是否会完全掌控自己的生活，并能够以全新而令人兴奋的方式表达自己？

ex.s: Suppose you are in charge of the Shy and Mighty Society, what will you do to help other shy people?
ex.t: 假设你是“害羞者与强者协会”的负责人，你会做什么来帮助其他害羞的人？

ex.s: The movements of the black and white pieces reflect the basic ideas of Eastern philosophy, according to Tu Ningning, who is in charge of the exhibition.
ex.t: 据负责此次展览的涂宁宁介绍，黑白棋子的走势反映了东方哲学的基本思想。

defs.def: a person that you have responsibility for and care for 被照管的人；受照料者
the amount of electricity that is put into a battery or carried by a substance （电池或带电物质的）充电量，电荷
a sudden rush or violent attack, for example by soldiers, wild animals or players in some sports 突然猛冲；猛攻；冲锋

ex.s: Though DIY has traditionally been seen as male hobby, the research shows it is women now leading the charge.
ex.t: 尽管DIY传统上被视为男性的爱好，但研究显示，如今是女性冲在最前面。

defs.def: the amount of explosive needed to fire a gun or make an explosion （射击或爆炸需要的）炸药量
the power to cause strong feelings 感染力；震撼力
a task or duty 任务；责任
to ask an amount of money for goods or a service 收费；要价

ex.s: There are plenty of other benefits, too; it doesn’t charge city tax; it has both air conditioning and a heater for the rooms; it also has free Wi-Fi in every room.
ex.t: 还有很多其他好处：不收城市税；房间里有空调和暖气；每个房间还有免费Wi-Fi。

ex.s: She charged very low fees to treat patients and often reduced costs for poor patients.
ex.t: 她对治疗患者收取非常低的费用，并经常降低贫困患者的成本。

ex.s: If your card has been lost, a fee of £5 is charged for the production of a replacement card.
ex.t: 如果你的卡丢失，补发卡将收取5英镑费用。

ex.s: Far from charging consumers high prices, many of these services are free (users pay, in effect, by handing over yet more data).
ex.t: 远非向消费者收取高价，许多这类服务都是免费的（用户实际上是通过交出更多数据来付费的）。

ex.s: favour bigger firmsD. charge higher prices
ex.t: 偏爱大公司D. 收取更高的价格

ex.s: It charges for Wi-Fi.
ex.t: Wi-Fi收费。

defs.def: to record the cost of sth as an amount that sb has to pay 把 … 记在账上；在某人账上记入
to accuse sb formally of a crime so that there can be a trial in court 控告；起诉
to accuse sb publicly of doing sth wrong or bad 指责；谴责
to rush forward and attack sb/sth 猛冲；猛攻；冲锋
to rush in a particular direction 向 … 方向冲去

ex.s: The noise shakes the trees as the male beats his chest and charges toward me.
ex.t: 雄性大猩猩捶打胸口向我冲来的声音震动了树木。

ex.s: After some wild warm up, I charged into the lake along with others.
ex.t: 一番疯狂热身之后，我和其他人一起冲进湖里。

ex.s: As Helen walked on, she heard a man charging towards her.
ex.t: 当海伦继续走时，她听到一个男人朝她冲过来。

defs.def: to pass electricity through sth so that it is stored there 充电

ex.s: Little do they know that as they do so, a burst of energy is sent up to street level to help charge an electric car.
ex.t: 他们几乎不知道，在这么做的同时，一股能量被传送到街道层面，用来给一辆电动汽车充电。

ex.s: Where to find a charging point.
ex.t: 在哪里能找到充电桩。

defs.def: to give sb a responsibility or task 通常用于被动语态
to fill sb with an emotion 通常用于被动语态
to fill a glass 注满（玻璃杯）
to load a gun 装（弹药）
